title: The Snack Line and a Place Held
youtube_title: The Snack Line and a Place Held | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friends can change the plan so both can play.
summary: At a ferry deck with a rail and two elbows of room, Milo is just outside the fun, close to a place held in a snack line. Dori changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Milo has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Neighbor Sami lets the children solve it.
